description: User directed 2026-11-19: "add the elixir parity issues as tickets to the epic we gave to Elixir Parity". Owner: Elixir Parity. Found by Elixir Parity. Elixir's ~w(a, b) warns about the trailing comma via IO.warn at expansion; fz has no way for a macro to warn, so the port drops it. Done: a macro's IO.warn surfaces as a compile diagnostic warning, and sigil_w uses it.
title: A macro can emit a compile-time warning
